label: The partial antenna ratio
subgoals: Compute the gate-connected metal area on the layer
Compute the total gate area the metal connects to
Divide metal area by gate area

label: The longest legal wire
subgoals: Multiply the maximum ratio by the gate area
Divide by the wire width to get the longest legal length
Insert a jumper or a diode when the route is longer

label: Cumulative ratios
subgoals: Sum the partial ratios up to the current layer
Compare the cumulative ratio with its limit
